states.name: Alabama
states.about: Alabama has no statewide bingo license. Bingo is allowed only where voters approved a local amendment to the state constitution, and only for charitable purposes. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Alabama Attorney General: court rulings on bingo
states.regulator_note: Local rules decide who may run bingo in each place. For questions about a game, ask the county sheriff's office or the county commission where it is held.

states.name: Alaska
states.about: Alaska allows bingo as charitable gaming under permits from the state Department of Revenue. The state's Revenue Online site has a search for permits and licenses. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.list_label: Alaska permit and license search (Revenue Online)
states.regulator_label: Alaska Department of Revenue: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Alaska charitable gaming, including bingo, runs under permits and licenses from the Department of Revenue's Tax Division, 907-465-2581.

states.name: Arizona
states.about: Arizona licenses bingo through the Department of Revenue. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Arizona Department of Revenue: Bingo in Arizona
states.regulator_note: Arizona bingo is licensed by the Department of Revenue's Bingo Section, 602-716-7801.

states.name: Arkansas
states.about: Arkansas lets long-standing nonprofit organizations run bingo under a state permit. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration: Bingo and Raffle
states.regulator_note: Arkansas bingo permits come from the Department of Finance and Administration's Miscellaneous Tax Section, 501-682-7187.

states.name: California
states.about: California has no statewide bingo license. State law lets each city or county allow charity bingo by local ordinance, so licenses come from the city or county. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: California bingo law (Penal Code section 326.5)
states.regulator_note: For questions about a game or a license, contact the city or county where the game is held.

states.name: Colorado
states.about: Colorado licenses bingo and raffles through the Secretary of State. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Colorado Secretary of State: Bingo and Raffles
states.regulator_note: Colorado bingo licenses come from the Secretary of State's office, 303-894-2200.

states.name: Connecticut
states.about: In Connecticut each town or city decides whether to allow bingo, and the town or city issues the permits. There is no statewide list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection: bingo, bazaar and raffle information
states.regulator_note: For questions about a game or a permit, contact the town or city where it is held. The state Department of Consumer Protection handles only sealed tickets and equipment dealers.

states.name: Delaware
states.about: Delaware allows bingo by volunteer fire companies and by veterans, religious, charitable and fraternal groups, under permits from the state Board of Charitable Gaming. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Delaware Board of Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Delaware bingo permits come from the Board of Charitable Gaming at the Division of Professional Regulation, 302-744-4500.

states.name: District of Columbia
states.about: In Washington, DC, charitable bingo is licensed by the DC Lottery, which posts a calendar of licensed charitable events. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: DC Lottery: Charitable Games
states.regulator_note: DC charitable gaming, including bingo, is licensed by the Office of Lottery and Gaming, 202-645-8000.

states.name: Florida
states.about: Florida does not license bingo statewide, so there is no state list of games. We're building one from places that publish their own schedules, with help from halls and players.
states.hours_note: Game days come from each place's own published schedule. Call ahead to confirm.
states.regulator_label: Florida law on bingo (section 849.0931)
states.regulator_note: Under Florida law, charities, veterans' groups and some homeowners' and mobile home park associations may run bingo; some counties, such as Pinellas, also license it locally.

states.name: Georgia
states.about: Georgia allows bingo run by licensed nonprofit groups. The Secretary of State took over bingo licensing from the Georgia Bureau of Investigation in 2021. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Georgia Secretary of State: Charity Bingo
states.regulator_note: Georgia bingo licenses come from the Secretary of State's Office of Charity Bingo, 404-656-2881.

states.name: Hawaii
states.about: Hawaii does not license bingo. State law treats paying to play a game of chance for a prize as gambling, so there are no bingo halls. We list only free games in Hawaii, such as senior center or community games where nobody pays to play.
states.regulator_label: Hawaii gambling law (Hawaii Revised Statutes 712-1220)
states.regulator_note: No state office licenses bingo in Hawaii.

states.name: Idaho
states.about: Idaho licenses charitable bingo through the Idaho Lottery, which publishes a list of licensed organizations. It does not give game days, so we're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.list_label: Idaho Lottery list of licensed organizations
states.regulator_label: Idaho Lottery: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Idaho bingo licenses come from the Idaho Lottery's charitable gaming office, 208-334-2277. Small games may not need a license, so the state list does not show every game.

states.name: Illinois
states.about: Illinois licenses bingo statewide through the Department of Revenue. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Illinois Department of Revenue: Bingo
states.regulator_note: Illinois bingo licenses come from the Department of Revenue's Office of Bingo and Charitable Games, 217-558-7425.

states.name: Indiana
states.about: The Indiana Gaming Commission lists groups with a current license that allows bingo. Its list does not show game days or times.
states.license_note: Indiana's license list shows this group can hold bingo, but not when. Call or look them up before you go.
states.list_label: Indiana Gaming Commission: Qualified Organizations with Current Licenses
states.regulator_label: Indiana Gaming Commission, Charity Gaming
states.regulator_note: Indiana bingo is licensed by the Indiana Gaming Commission's Charity Gaming Division, 317-232-4646.

states.name: Iowa
states.about: Iowa requires a charitable gambling license to run bingo, issued by the Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing: Charitable Gambling
states.regulator_note: Iowa bingo falls under charitable gambling licenses from the Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing, 515-281-6848.

states.name: Kansas
states.about: Kansas licenses bingo through the Department of Revenue, which publishes a list of licensed bingo organizations. It does not give game days, so we're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.list_label: Kansas list of licensed bingo organizations (PDF)
states.regulator_label: Kansas Department of Revenue: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Kansas bingo is limited to nonprofit religious, charitable, fraternal, educational and veterans organizations licensed by the Department of Revenue, 785-368-8222.

states.name: Kentucky
states.about: We haven't found a public list of Kentucky bingo games yet, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Kentucky Office of Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Kentucky bingo is licensed by the Office of Charitable Gaming, now part of Kentucky Horse Racing & Gaming.

states.name: Louisiana
states.about: Louisiana licenses charitable bingo through the Office of Charitable Gaming, which has a license search by name. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Louisiana Office of Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Louisiana charitable gaming, including bingo, is licensed and regulated by the Office of Charitable Gaming at the Louisiana Department of Revenue.

states.name: Maine
states.about: In Maine, bingo is often called beano. It is overseen by the state Gambling Control Unit, which publishes a list of charitable gaming organizations. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.list_label: Maine list of charitable gaming organizations (PDF)
states.regulator_label: Maine Gambling Control Unit: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Maine beano and bingo are licensed or registered by the Gambling Control Unit at the Department of Public Safety, 207-626-3900.

states.name: Maryland
states.about: Maryland has no statewide bingo license. State law sets the rules county by county, and each county names who issues bingo licenses or permits. There is no statewide list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Maryland law: local bingo rules (Criminal Law, Title 13)
states.regulator_note: For questions about a game or a license, contact the county where it is held. Depending on the county, that may be the sheriff, the county commissioners or a county permits office.

states.name: Massachusetts
states.about: In Massachusetts, bingo is called beano and is licensed by the State Lottery Commission. We haven't found a public list of game days yet, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Massachusetts: questions about nonprofit gaming events
states.regulator_note: Massachusetts beano is licensed by the Massachusetts State Lottery Commission, 781-849-5555.

states.name: Michigan
states.about: Michigan's Charitable Gaming Division lists licensed weekly bingo games with the day and hours.
states.hours_note: Hours come from Michigan's weekly bingo license list. Call ahead to ask when the first game starts.
states.list_label: Michigan Charitable Gaming Division: Find a Weekly Bingo
states.regulator_label: Michigan Charitable Gaming Division
states.regulator_note: Michigan bingo is licensed by the Michigan Lottery's Charitable Gaming Division, 517-335-5780.

states.name: Minnesota
states.about: Minnesota licenses bingo as lawful gambling through the Gambling Control Board. The board's website lists licensed organizations and the sites where they operate. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Minnesota Gambling Control Board
states.regulator_note: Minnesota bingo is run by nonprofit organizations licensed or authorized by the Gambling Control Board, 651-539-1900.

states.name: Mississippi
states.about: Mississippi licenses charitable bingo through the Mississippi Gaming Commission, which keeps a map of charitable gaming licensees. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.list_label: Mississippi map of charitable gaming licensees
states.regulator_label: Mississippi Gaming Commission: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Mississippi charitable bingo is licensed by the Mississippi Gaming Commission.

states.name: Missouri
states.about: Missouri licenses bingo statewide through the Missouri Gaming Commission. We haven't found a public list of game days yet, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Missouri Gaming Commission: Charitable Games Division
states.regulator_note: Missouri bingo is licensed by the Missouri Gaming Commission's Charitable Games Division. Only licensed religious, charitable, fraternal, veteran and service organizations may run it.

states.name: Montana
states.about: Montana allows live bingo under permits from the state Gambling Control Division, which publishes a list of places that offer live keno or bingo. Many are bars, casinos and clubs.
states.license_note: Montana's list names places with a permit for live bingo. It does not show game days or times, so call before you go. Places the list shows only with a mailing address are not shown here; the state list has them.
states.list_label: Montana list of places offering live keno or bingo (PDF)
states.regulator_label: Montana Department of Justice: Gambling Control Division
states.regulator_note: Montana live bingo permits come from the Department of Justice's Gambling Control Division, 406-444-1971.

states.name: Nebraska
states.about: Nebraska licenses bingo through the Department of Revenue's Charitable Gaming Division. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Charitable Gaming, Bingo
states.regulator_note: Nebraska bingo is regulated under the Nebraska Bingo Act by the Department of Revenue's Charitable Gaming Division, 402-471-5729.

states.name: Nevada
states.about: In Nevada, bingo is one of the games casinos are licensed to offer, and charities that raise money with bingo register with the Nevada Gaming Control Board. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Nevada Gaming Control Board
states.regulator_note: Nevada gaming, including bingo, is regulated by the Nevada Gaming Control Board, 702-486-2000.

states.name: New Hampshire
states.about: New Hampshire licenses bingo for charitable organizations through the state Lottery Commission. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: New Hampshire Lottery: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: New Hampshire bingo licenses come from the New Hampshire Lottery Commission, 603-271-3391.

states.name: New Jersey
states.about: In New Jersey, a group first registers with the state's Legalized Games of Chance Control Commission and then gets its bingo license from the town where it plays. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: New Jersey Legalized Games of Chance Control Commission
states.regulator_note: New Jersey bingo is overseen by the Legalized Games of Chance Control Commission, part of the Division of Consumer Affairs, 973-273-8000. The local license comes from the municipal clerk.

states.name: New Mexico
states.about: New Mexico's Gaming Control Board oversees bingo and posts a map and contact list of bingo, raffle and pull-tab locations. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.list_label: New Mexico map of bingo, raffle and pull-tab locations
states.regulator_label: New Mexico Gaming Control Board
states.regulator_note: New Mexico bingo is overseen by the New Mexico Gaming Control Board, 505-841-9700.

states.name: New York
states.about: New York bingo licenses come from each city, town or village, so there is no statewide list of games. We're building one from places that publish their own schedules, with help from halls and players.
states.hours_note: Game days come from each place's own published schedule. Call ahead to confirm.
states.regulator_label: New York State Gaming Commission: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: In New York, a group first gets a bingo identification number from the State Gaming Commission's Division of Charitable Gaming, and the license itself comes from the local city, town or village clerk.

states.name: North Carolina
states.about: North Carolina allows bingo only for charitable organizations with a state Charitable Bingo License. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: North Carolina Alcohol Law Enforcement: Bingo
states.regulator_note: North Carolina bingo licenses come from the Bingo Administrator at Alcohol Law Enforcement, 919-710-8885.

states.name: North Dakota
states.about: North Dakota licenses charitable gaming, which includes bingo, through the Attorney General's Gaming Division. The division publishes lists of licensed organizations and gaming sites. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.list_label: North Dakota lists of licensed gaming organizations and sites
states.regulator_label: North Dakota Attorney General: Gaming
states.regulator_note: North Dakota charitable gaming is regulated by the Attorney General's Gaming Division. The Attorney General's office is at 701-328-2210.

states.name: Ohio
states.about: Ohio has its own free bingo finder with game days and times, from the same team.
states.list_label: Ohio Attorney General: authorized bingo locations
states.regulator_label: Ohio Attorney General, charitable bingo
states.regulator_note: Ohio bingo is licensed by the Ohio Attorney General.

states.name: Oklahoma
states.about: Oklahoma licenses charity bingo through the ABLE Commission. Hospitals, nursing homes and senior centers that host bingo for residents can get an exemption. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Oklahoma ABLE Commission: Charity Games License Guide
states.regulator_note: Oklahoma charity games licenses, including bingo, come from the Alcoholic Beverage Laws Enforcement (ABLE) Commission, 405-521-3484.

states.name: Oregon
states.about: Oregon licenses charitable bingo through the Department of Justice. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Oregon Department of Justice: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Oregon bingo licenses come from the Department of Justice's Gaming Section, 971-673-1880.

states.name: Pennsylvania
states.about: Pennsylvania bingo licenses come from each county, so there is no statewide list of games. We're building one from places that publish their own schedules, with help from halls and players.
states.hours_note: Game days come from each place's own published schedule. Call ahead to confirm.
states.regulator_label: How county bingo licenses work (Cumberland County example)
states.regulator_note: In Pennsylvania, bingo licenses are issued by each county treasurer's office.

states.name: Rhode Island
states.about: Rhode Island licenses bingo through the State Police Charitable Gaming Unit. After state approval, the group gets its license from the city or town. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Rhode Island State Police: Charitable Gaming Unit
states.regulator_note: Rhode Island bingo is licensed and regulated by the Superintendent of State Police through the Charitable Gaming Unit, 401-764-5568.

states.name: South Carolina
states.about: South Carolina allows nonprofit charitable organizations to run bingo under a license from the Department of Revenue. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: South Carolina Department of Revenue: Bingo
states.regulator_note: South Carolina bingo licenses come from the Department of Revenue, 803-898-5393.

states.name: South Dakota
states.about: South Dakota has no state bingo license. State law lets veterans, religious, charitable, educational, fraternal and civic groups and volunteer fire departments run bingo after giving written notice to the county or city where they play. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: South Dakota law on bingo (SDCL 22-25-25)
states.regulator_note: For questions about a game, contact the county or city government where it is held.

states.name: Tennessee
states.about: Tennessee does not license weekly bingo. Under the Tennessee Nonprofit Gaming Law, an eligible nonprofit can hold a yearly game-of-chance fundraising event, and bingo is one of the games allowed. The Secretary of State's office takes the applications and has a search for the events.
states.regulator_label: Tennessee Secretary of State: Charitable Gaming Event FAQs
states.regulator_note: Questions go to the Secretary of State's Charitable Solicitations office, 615-741-2555.

states.name: Texas
states.about: Texas licenses charitable bingo statewide, and the state's Bingo Hall Locator lists each licensed hall with its days and times.
states.hours_note: Hours are the licensed bingo times from the Texas Bingo Hall Locator. Call ahead to confirm before you go.
states.regulator_label: Texas charitable bingo (txbingo.org)
states.regulator_note: Texas bingo was regulated by the Texas Lottery Commission until 2025, when the Legislature moved it to the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation. The bingo line is 800-246-4677.

states.name: Utah
states.about: Utah does not license bingo, and state law does not allow gambling. The bingo we list in Utah is free bingo at senior centers. We're building the list with help from centers and players.
states.hours_note: Game days come from each center's own published schedule. Call ahead to confirm.
states.regulator_label: Utah Code: gambling (section 76-9-1402)
states.regulator_note: Utah has no bingo regulator. State law prohibits gambling, so the places listed here offer bingo free of charge.

states.name: Vermont
states.about: Vermont has no state bingo license. State law lets nonprofit organizations run games of chance, including bingo, to raise money for charitable, religious, educational and civic work. We haven't found a public list of games, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Vermont law on nonprofit games of chance (13 V.S.A. § 2143)
states.regulator_note: No state office licenses bingo in Vermont.

states.name: Virginia
states.about: Virginia's Office of Charitable and Regulatory Programs publishes a directory of bingo sessions, with the days and the times the doors open and close. Games marked "in the social quarters" may be for members and their guests, so call first.
states.hours_note: Hours are when the doors open and close, from Virginia's directory of bingo sessions. Call ahead to ask when the first game starts.
states.regulator_label: Virginia Office of Charitable and Regulatory Programs: Charitable Gaming
states.regulator_note: Virginia charitable gaming permits come from the Office of Charitable and Regulatory Programs at the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services. Its complaint line is 804-371-0498.

states.name: Washington
states.about: Washington oversees nonprofit bingo through the Washington State Gambling Commission, which has a lookup for licensed organizations. We're building a list of days and times with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: Washington State Gambling Commission
states.regulator_note: Washington bingo is overseen by the Washington State Gambling Commission.

states.name: West Virginia
states.about: We haven't found a public list of West Virginia bingo games yet, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: West Virginia Tax Division: bingo and raffle licenses
states.regulator_note: West Virginia bingo is licensed by the State Tax Commissioner, 304-558-3333.

states.regulator_note: Wisconsin bingo licenses come from the Division of Gaming's Office of Charitable Gaming, 608-270-2530.

states.name: Wyoming

states.regulator_note: Wyoming bingo licenses come from the Wyoming Gaming Commission, 307-265-4015.
